questions.question: You are approaching the crest of a hill on a two-way road. Under which condition is overtaking allowed?

options.text: Overtaking is always prohibited near a crest
If no oncoming vehicles are visible at that moment
If you can overtake without entering the right-hand side of the road

questions.question: What is the difference between an intersection and a junction?

options.text: A junction is the smaller area within an intersection
An intersection is only where roads cross at 90 degrees
There is no difference between the two

questions.question: A holder of a Code 1 learner’s licence is riding a motorcycle. Which of the following is allowed?

options.text: Carrying one passenger if the rider is over 18
Riding alone without carrying any passengers
Riding any motorcycle regardless of engine size

questions.question: When must the lights of a motor vehicle be switched on?

options.text: Only between sunset and sunrise
When visibility is less than 100 metres
Between sunset and sunrise AND when visibility is poor

questions.question: Which of the following BEST describes a public road?

options.text: Any road owned by the government
Any road with tar or concrete surface
Any place commonly used by the public or where the public has access

questions.question: When is it compulsory to use direction indicators?

options.text: Only when turning at intersections
When turning AND when changing lanes
Only when other vehicles are nearby

questions.question: When is a driver of a light motor vehicle allowed to drive on the shoulder of the road?

options.text: At any time to overtake slower vehicles
Only at night when traffic is heavy
During daylight, when being overtaken, and if it is safe

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT allowed when transporting goods on a vehicle?

options.text: Goods that obstruct the driver’s view of the rear-view mirror
Goods secured properly but slightly above roof height
Goods fastened securely within the vehicle

questions.question: If your vehicle breaks down on a public road, where must you place the emergency warning triangle?

options.text: At least 30 metres behind the vehicle
At least 45 metres behind the vehicle, facing oncoming traffic
Directly behind the vehicle

questions.question: Which statement about wearing seatbelts is correct?

options.text: Seatbelts are not required when driving slowly in a parking area
A driver is only responsible for ensuring children wear seatbelts
Seatbelts are not required when reversing or manoeuvring in a parking area

questions.question: A driver signals to turn right but continues straight. What should other road users do?

options.text: Assume the driver will turn and proceed accordingly
Proceed based on the signal shown
Act with caution and not rely solely on the signal

questions.question: You are driving during the day in heavy mist where visibility is reduced. What is the correct action?

options.text: Use parking lights only
Switch on headlights
Only use hazard lights

questions.question: Which of the following places is most likely considered a public road?

options.text: A private farm road with a locked gate
A shopping centre parking lot open to the public
A driveway inside a residential property

questions.question: You intend to overtake a vehicle. When are you allowed to return to the left side of the road?

options.text: As soon as your front wheels pass the other vehicle
Once you are fully clear of the vehicle you passed
As soon as there is space in front of the vehicle

questions.question: An overhead lane-use control sign indicates that the lane below it is subject to a regulatory requirement. What does this sign instruct you to do?

options.text: You must use the lane only if you intend to travel at a speed of at least 60 km/h
You should try to maintain a speed close to 60 km/h when traffic conditions allow
You may use the lane at any speed, provided you do not exceed the general speed limit

questions.question: While driving at 80 km/h on a rural road, you see a Surface Step warning sign ahead. There are no other vehicles nearby. What is the most correct action you should take?

options.text: Maintain speed but grip the steering wheel firmly to handle the bump
Gradually reduce speed and prepare for uneven road levels between lanes or road edges
Immediately brake hard just before reaching the step to avoid suspension damage

questions.question: You are driving at night on a public road. At what minimum distance must your main beam headlights allow you to clearly see a person or object ahead?

options.text: 45 metres
75 metres
100 metres

questions.question: You are driving on a busy road and notice this temporary warning sign placed ahead. Traffic is flowing normally, and no obstruction is yet visible. What is the MOST appropriate response?

options.text: Continue at the same speed but stay alert for stopped vehicles
Immediately change lanes to avoid potential obstruction ahead
Reduce speed, increase following distance, and be prepared for sudden hazards

questions.question: You park your vehicle at night on a public road. In which situation are you NOT required to keep your vehicle’s lights on?

options.text: When parked on the roadway in a dark area
When parked within 12 metres of a working streetlight illuminating the road
When parked facing oncoming traffic

questions.question: You are driving at dusk on a rural road and see this warning sign. The road ahead appears clear with no animals visible. What is the MOST correct action?

options.text: Continue at the same speed since no animals are currently visible
Reduce speed and remain alert, as animals may suddenly enter the road
Sound your horn repeatedly to scare away any animals nearby

questions.question: Which of the following BEST describes a parking situation in terms of road traffic law?

options.text: Keeping a vehicle stationary longer than necessary for loading or unloading
Stopping a vehicle briefly to drop off a passenger
Any time a vehicle is not moving, regardless of reason

questions.question: You are driving on a road where this temporary warning sign is displayed. Traffic is light and you cannot yet see any roadworkers or signals. What is the MOST correct action?

options.text: Maintain speed until you can clearly see the stop/go controller
Slow down and prepare to stop, anticipating manual traffic control ahead
Overtake any slow vehicles ahead before reaching the control point

questions.question: What is the minimum legal tread depth for tyres on a motor vehicle?

options.text: 0.8 mm across the entire tyre
1 mm across the entire tyre
1mm across the full circumference, excluding sidewalls

questions.question: Who is legally responsible if a passenger in your vehicle does not wear a seatbelt when required?

options.text: Both the driver and the passenger
The driver only
The passenger only

questions.question: A driver must always maintain full control of their vehicle. Which of the following BEST describes this requirement?

options.text: Keeping both hands on the steering wheel at all times
Being able to stop the vehicle within the visible distance ahead
Driving below the speed limit at all times

questions.question: You are driving a delivery vehicle and approach a road with a sign displaying two specified time periods. You arrive outside of those times displayed. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed with caution, but be prepared to turn around if stopped by authorities
Avoid entering, as delivery vehicles are generally restricted on that road
Proceed beyond the sign, as the restriction only applies during the specified times

questions.question: You are driving on a public road and approach a pedestrian crossing where no pedestrians are currently on the crossing. However, a pedestrian is standing on the sidewalk, looking toward the road. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop, as the pedestrian may intend to cross
Stop immediately to allow the pedestrian the opportunity to cross
Continue driving, as the pedestrian has not yet stepped onto the crossing

questions.question: You are driving a vehicle conveying dangerous goods and pass this sign. Traffic ahead becomes congested, forcing vehicles to slow down significantly. What should you do?

options.text: Stop if necessary, as you are forced to do so by traffic conditions
Continue driving slowly with the flow of traffic, even if movement is minimal
Pull over and stop only if it is safe and out of the way of traffic

questions.question: You are driving on a road with a single continuous white line on your side. You notice a slow-moving vehicle ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Overtake the vehicle if the road ahead looks clear, but only if safe
Stay behind the vehicle until the line ends, regardless of traffic behind you
Move slightly into the oncoming lane to pass, if no oncoming traffic is visible

questions.question: You are driving a vehicle with a GVM exceeding the indicated limit and come across this sign. What should you do?

options.text: Avoid turning left and proceed straight or choose an alternative route
Turn left carefully, ensuring you do not obstruct traffic
Turn left only if the road appears wide enough to accommodate your vehicle

questions.question: You are driving in heavy rain with poor visibility. You approach an intersection where the traffic light has just turned yellow. What should you do?

options.text: Continue at the same speed, assuming other drivers will adjust around you
Speed up slightly to cross before it turns red, to avoid stopping in the intersection
Slow down and prepare to stop, even if it means stopping abruptly

questions.question: You are riding a motorcycle on a road where this sign is displayed. What should you do?

options.text: Follow the speed of surrounding traffic to maintain flow
Exceed the indicated motorcycle speed limit only when it is safe to do so
Ensure you do not exceed the maximum indicated specifically for motorcycles

questions.question: You are driving behind a vehicle that suddenly slows down in the road without any visible reason. There are no brake lights, hazards, or obstacles ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Immediately overtake the vehicle, as it is creating an unnecessary obstruction
Reduce speed and maintain a safe following distance while assessing the situation
Flash your headlights and prepare to pass as soon as possible

questions.question: You are driving a motor car and approach a road where a sign indicates that motor cars are prohibited beyond the sign during a specified time period. You arrive just before the restricted time begins. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed beyond the sign before the restricted time begins
Avoid entering, as the restriction will apply shortly
Wait until the restricted time has passed before entering

questions.question: You are driving on a multi-lane road. A vehicle in the lane next to you begins drifting slightly toward your lane without indicating. What should you do?

options.text: Maintain your speed and position, as you have the right of way in your lane
Sound your hooter to warn the driver and continue driving as normal
Reduce speed and create space to avoid a potential collision
